sections.h2: IndianOil plans to lift its petrochemical share of crude from 6.5% to 15%

chart.title: IndianOil's target more than doubles its petrochemical intensity by 2030
chart.sub: Share of crude converted into petrochemicals, %.
chart.source: IOCL Q1 FY27 earnings call; S&P Global.

sections.means: IndianOil's own petrochemical share is planned to rise from about 6.5% to 15% of the crude it processes by 2030, funded by a ₹1 trillion programme.
sections.todo: Track whether the Panipat, Gujarat and Barauni expansions finish on the FY27 timetable the company has set.

sections.h2: BPCL's Bina project leans on a ₹31,802 crore bank loan

chart.title: A single syndicated loan carries most of BPCL's ₹48,926 crore Bina project

sections.means: BPCL's refinery and petrochemical expansion at Bina is financed mainly through a project-finance consortium rather than a corporate bond issue.
sections.todo: Check the loan drawdowns against the project cost as the Bina complex is commissioned.

sections.h2: About 30% of IndianOil's ₹15,000 crore raise is planned in foreign currency

chart.title: IndianOil's debt split is about 70% domestic bonds and 30% foreign currency

sections.means: The foreign-currency leg, sized at $500 million to $1 billion, is tied to interest rate trends, so its size can move with the rate outlook.
sections.todo: Watch the three-to-five-year tenor and the final size of the foreign leg once rates are set.

sections.h2: India's refining target rises to 450 MMTPA by 2030 from about 258 today

chart.title: The national refining target is roughly 74% above today's capacity
chart.source: Government target, as reported in the post.

sections.means: The national refining target is set at 450 MMTPA by 2030, with new refineries planned as integrated petrochemical complexes from the outset.
sections.todo: Compare announced petrochemical capacity against the 2030 refining target as projects are completed.
